scope: Exploratory source-fidelity audit, not an accuracy estimate or before/after improvement test

selection.rule: Assigned domain pools, first usable complete recipes; source annotation frozen before any extractor run. All acquisition/selection failures retained; no output-based exclusions. URLs canonicalized before extraction. English-language convenience sample, not a randomized holdout.

a-borough-recipe.notes: Image and book credits become two extra steps. Credits are already inside publisher JSON-LD instructions, so this is not solely a DOM fallback fault.

a-river-recipe.notes: Dressing boundary is lost while method refers to all dressing ingredients; cooking ownership becomes ambiguous.

a-brindisa-recipe.notes: A shopping section heading plus20 commercial rows added to ingredient list: retail pack quantities, prices, product descriptions and controls. Relevant note and repeated sentence become steps. Original ingredient/component overlap is a source ambiguity, not counted as this defect.

a-belazu-recipe.notes: Ingredient groups and cooking content retained; explicit servings absent.

b-hod-recipe.notes: Share label becomes a step. Separate ragù subrecipe yield10–12 stays in its heading; overall servings4 is absent.

b-ott-recipe.notes: All original ingredient quantities and steps retained but batter group and explicit servings absent.

b-sous-recipe.notes: Copyright line becomes a step. No explicit yield field to score; final serving instruction alone was not turned into an oracle value.

b-pipers-recipe.notes: No mismatch in annotated fields. Requested Pipers Farm page declares Edenmoor canonical; canonical identity used consistently before extraction. Not proof every possible metadata field is complete.

limitations: Baseline raw extraction only: did not mutate code, strip structured data, compare another scraper or change fixtures after output.
No new UI or installed-PWA suite was run; this tests detached HTML extraction, not acquisition or rendering.
No new failures found would not establish their absence: 8 selected recipes and4 negatives cannot estimate population error rates or rule out rare defects.
Source contradictions retained; canonical URL does not establish an observed HTTP redirect.
Raw HTML is UTF8-decoded output of Pi tool, not original HTTP wire bytes; selected bodies matched tool byte counts and were not truncated.
